brand.name: MADAM BOUTIQUE & MADAM FASHIONS
brand.vibe: Premium, elegant, traditional Indian craftsmanship + contemporary boutique elegance.

rules: Never use Inter or generic sans for headings.
Use tight letter spacing for large headings.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).

motifs: Subtle Indian floral/paisley line-art corners in light silver/blue-grey.
Thin divider ornaments (1px solid with a tiny central diamond or dot).

cards.auth_card: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/40 shadow-xl p-8 sm:p-12 rounded-lg

buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary hover:text-white transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-sm font-medium tracking-wide

surfaces.header: bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-accent/20 sticky top-0 z-50

spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 lg:gap-12

images.description: Woman in a blue embroidered dress with a tan shawl
Soft folds of cream/white silk fabric
A man sitting next to a little girl on a chair - elegant portrait

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. White text on primary blue passes.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: Use React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide React (for icons like phone, mail, social, motifs).
instructions_to_main_agent.auth_flow: Build Login form, Signup form with radio buttons (Business/Individual), Forgot Password, Account page.
instructions_to_main_agent.animations: Use subtle fade-in and slide-up animations for cards and text using Framer Motion.
instructions_to_main_agent.images: Use the provided Unsplash URLs. DO NOT use placeholder text.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' outputs. Use generous spacing.
Do not use transparent backgrounds under content.
Use Phosphor or Lucide icons, never AI emojis.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus).
